description: The figure presents four pie charts, each representing the distribution of categories for a specific model: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has 5 slices, with "Misinformation" (orange) at 38.4%, "Lack of Knowledge" (blue) at 22.1%, "Ethical Advice" (dark blue) at 16.3%, "Clarification" (yellow) at 14.0%, and "Safety" (red) at 9.3%. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has 2 slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" (orange) at 75.0% and "Clarification" (red) at 25.0%. The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart has 2 slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" (orange) and "Misinformation" (red) both at 50.0%. All charts display percentage labels inside the slices, and the colors are distinguishable, but there is no legend provided. The slices in each chart are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way beyond their proportional size.
